name: aggregate-int64-sum-scalar
$comment: SUM over an int64 field projects the exact decimal STRING — the int64 wire convention the field's own reads/writes already follow — not a JSON number: 2^53+1 plus 2 is 9007199254740995, odd and past 2^53, which no IEEE-754 double can carry. The string expectation compares byte-exact, pinning the convention on all six runners.
